nodes.name: Anonymous / Remote User
nodes.description: Unauthenticated network caller reaching the OpenMRS web application.
assumptions: Deployment exposure is not stated in the repo; assumed reachable from a clinic/hospital LAN and possibly the internet.

nodes.name: Clinician / Authenticated User
nodes.description: Authenticated OpenMRS users holding role-based privileges (clinicians, data clerks).

nodes.name: System Administrator
nodes.description: Super users / administrators who run setup, DB updates, manage users, scheduler and modules.

nodes.name: OpenMRS Web Application
nodes.description: WAR (web + webapp modules) exposing Spring MVC/servlet/JSP UI behind a servlet filter chain; REST/FHIR UI arrive as loadable modules.
assumptions: Authentication mechanism assumed from OpenMRS design; no auth code was read.

nodes.name: Startup Filter Chain (Init/Update/Module Filters)
nodes.description: Servlet filters that run before Spring: InitializationFilter (first-run setup wizard), UpdateFilter (DB update wizard requiring super-user auth), StartupErrorFilter, ModuleFilter, OpenmrsFilter, CookieClearingFilter, GZIPFilter, JspClassLoaderFilter.
nodes.authentication: Super-user credentials in UpdateFilter (per Javadoc); none for first-run wizard

nodes.name: OpenMRS Service API (Context + Services)
nodes.description: api module services (Patient, Encounter, Order, Obs, Concept, User, Administration, Visit...). Methods guarded by @Authorized privileges (626 in api, 31 hl7, 14 scheduler).
assumptions: AOP enforcement of @Authorized assumed; enforcement code was not read. Interface annotations only prove declared intent.

nodes.name: Hibernate DAO / Persistence Layer
nodes.description: Hibernate ORM data access with c3p0 pooling and Lucene indexing.

nodes.name: Relational Database
nodes.description: Primary datastore; MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and H2 referenced by setup wizard.

nodes.name: Lucene Search Index
nodes.description: Lucene/Hibernate Search index of patient and concept data.

nodes.name: Runtime Properties & Application Data Directory
nodes.description: openmrs-runtime.properties and application data directory (DB settings, modules, logs).
assumptions: Credentials stored in a properties file (assumed; not verified).

nodes.name: Liquibase / DatabaseUpdater
nodes.description: Runs Liquibase changesets; getDatabaseChanges guarded by @Authorized(GET_DATABASE_CHANGES).

nodes.name: Module System (dynamically loaded modules)
nodes.description: OpenMRS module loader; .omod modules contribute code, filters, Spring config and privileges, loaded at runtime.
assumptions: Signature verification of modules is not evidenced.

nodes.name: HL7 Inbound Processing
nodes.description: HL7Service: queue, archive, error queue and processing of inbound HL7 v2.x messages (HAPI).

nodes.name: Email / Notification
nodes.description: javax.mail based notifications via external SMTP.

nodes.name: Container Runtime (Docker)
nodes.description: Dockerfile builds the web application image exposing 8080.

nodes.name: Build & Dependency Supply Chain (Maven)
nodes.description: Maven build pulling ~115 dependencies incl. log4j 1.2 bridge, log4j-core, commons-fileupload, c3p0, legacy jackson-mapper-asl.
assumptions: Dependency versions not reviewed; SCA required.
TLS termination not described; assumed reverse proxy.

edges.authentication: None on first run (all requests redirected to setup)
assumptions: Wizard is unauthenticated by design before init; exposure window depends on deployment.
Modules run with application privileges; no sandbox evidenced.
HL7 transport/auth is likely provided by modules; unknown.

business_workflows.name: First-Run Installation Wizard
business_workflows.goal: Initialize DB, schema, admin user and runtime properties on first start.

steps.name: Supply DB connection and admin DB credentials
steps.state_change_description: Creates DB and writes runtime properties

steps.name: Run Liquibase schema/demo data and create admin user
steps.state_change_description: Schema creation and admin account creation

invariants.statement: The setup wizard must be unreachable once the system is initialized.

business_workflows.name: Database Update Wizard
business_workflows.goal: Review and apply pending Liquibase changesets after an upgrade.

invariants.statement: Only an authenticated super user may trigger DB updates; S3 must re-verify the session from S1.

business_workflows.name: Clinical Order Lifecycle
business_workflows.goal: Place, revise, discontinue and fulfil clinical orders for a patient encounter.

invariants.statement: A user may act only on patients/locations they are permitted to access; ownership must be re-checked at every step.
A discontinued or voided order cannot be revised or fulfilled.

business_workflows.name: HL7 Message Intake and Processing
business_workflows.goal: Accept inbound HL7 messages, queue, process into clinical records, archive or error-queue.

steps.name: Parse and process into patient records
Archive or move to error queue

invariants.statement: Each HL7 message is processed exactly once and attributed to the correct patient.
